name: The R Villa Dempo

facts.text: 2 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, and 2 bathrooms.
A garden, a balcony, outdoor furniture and a private entrance.
Air conditioning, WiFi, a TV and a stereo sound system.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, toaster, blender and a refrigerator with freezer.
Safe, hair dryer and ironing board; linens are provided.
In Pererenan on Jalan Belulang Yeh, about 45 to 60 minutes by car from Ngurah Rai Airport.
